concerns.text: FR-005 requires threshold detection 'controlling for token frequency and n-gram probability', but no task implements covariate control in the threshold/change-point step. T005 applies covariate controls only to correlations; T007 fits piecewise models on repository aggregates with no control for token_count or ngram_probability. The confounder-control half of FR-005 has no covering task.

FR-002 mandates static analysis with 'CodeQL and tree-sitter'. T003 covers tree-sitter metrics but makes CodeQL optional ('may be dropped if the CLI is unavailable on the runner'). No task runs or even attempts CodeQL, so the CodeQL half of FR-002 has no covering task; either add a CodeQL attempt task or record a spec amendment.

concerns.text: Plan's dependency list includes 'seaborn' and 'pytest-cov', but T001's pinned requirements.txt enumerates neither. Also plan's structure defines code/inference/metrics.py (FR-004 loss/entropy calculation) and tests/contract/, but no task creates metrics.py (T004 folds loss/entropy into engine.py — acceptable by description) and no task creates contract tests (T012's inline jsonschema check partially covers). Minor plan-element drift; reconcile the dependency list at minimum.
